say:1:1122548001:1.text: Oh! Is that the purchase order? Let me take a look.
say:1:1122548001:1.source_cn: 哦！这是那位商人的进货单吗？让我仔细看看。

say:2:1122548002:1.text: Yes, this price is fine! It seems like this merchant doesn't like to haggle. I think we can work together for a long time.
say:2:1122548002:1.source_cn: ……嗯，还真达到了我要的价格！看来这位商人的砍价技巧不...

say:3:1122548003:1.text: By the way, thanks a lot! If I'm being honest, you're wasted as a bounty hunter. Here's your reward!
say:3:1122548003:1.source_cn: 多谢了！不愧是赏金猎人，什么委托都办得到！
